title: Tenma Saki — Visibly & Audibly Asleep〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: Tenma Household  - Living Room
se_run_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa! You gotta hear this♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? You seem to be in an awfully good mood, Saki. Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ You can tell, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Guess what? I ran into Shizuku earlier this morning...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Interesting. The Tenmas and Hinomoris going on a day trip together, eh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought we could use a break. We've all been super busy lately.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think you'll be free to go, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... We aren't supposed to start training with the next troupe for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll need to check with the others, but I should be able to go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The four of us don't often spend much time together, but it should be a fun trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
However...
Shizuku aside, I'm surprised Shiho agreed to come.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh!
Shizuku and I begged and pleaded for her to come.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She said yes after we told her that the three of us would plan everything out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, now I'm even more excited!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Naturally, for our “Leaf-Viewing Reattempt”, we're surely going to go see the leaves...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... But coming up with other things to do is much more difficult than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't worry! I just happen to have these handy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa!! I bought a bunch of travel magazines for us♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, these are perfect! We'll definitely need to do what research we can here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Hiking up a mountain, going glamping, riding gondola lifts...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So many ways to enjoy the leaves. And they all look incredibly fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I'm not sure which ones to pick.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But let's see what else we can do... Oh!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! Wh-What did you find, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look! There's a restaurant where you can listen to live music while enjoying the leaves at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The live music alone would be compelling enough, but to think that we'd also get to enjoy the leaves at the same... Now it has my full attention!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mine too. Let's bookmark this one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, here's an activity that's all about desserts made using chestnuts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Made using chestnuts?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Apparently, you gather chestnuts there and they'll roast them for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And the title of “Chestnut Champion” will be bestowed upon the person in each group who finds the largest one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and there's more...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The champion will be allowed to have as many chestnut desserts as they like!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Now I wanna win!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, let's also bookmark this one.
See anything else that you like?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This vineyard also has an all-you-can-eat activity!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, grapes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, didn't we go and pick grapes when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I remember them being unimaginably good since we picked them ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now I wanna go again.
This one's also a keeper!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The page next to it seems to be a special feature on a pear orchard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That'd also be a good choice.
All the crisp and juicy pears we can eat...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh... Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite the fact that we just had dinner, all this talk of food is making me hungry again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I know it's not good to snack at night, but we can't fight on empty stomachs.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How does some hot chocolate with whipped cream sound, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I found these really amazing marshmallows the other day! We should try throwing those in!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You're making it even more decadent...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think we've marked all the places we wanna check out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Now we need to whittle down our options.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know. Since she's going with us, why don't we ask Shizuku where she'd like to go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
We need to ask her about where she wants to go and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll message her.
Then, we'll meet up and discuss our trip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. The three of us will put our heads together...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And devise such an incredible travel itinerary that even Shiho won't believe her eyes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
